name: Deco-Luxe
summary: Deco-Luxe is a mélange of Art Deco & Streamline Moderne revivals that emerged mainly in the mid 1970s, and peaked in the 1980s and early 1990s.
description: Deco-Luxe is a mélange of Art Deco & Streamline Moderne revivals that emerged mainly in the mid 1970s, and peaked in the 1980s and early 1990s. It differs from the earlier Art Deco revival in the 1970s, Disco Deco , as it is more focused on the luxury side of Art Deco & the Roaring 20s, due to the rise of materialism and excess during the 1980s. [ 1 ] [ 2 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Luxury, glamor, status

visualDNA.Overview: The aesthetic is defined by sleek and glossy designs inspired by the Art Deco movement. The color palette consists of rich and cool jewel tones. For the interior architectural style, it shifts into clear indulgence where rooms incorporate extended open layouts anchored by oversized, high-end leathers or curvaceous seating concealed in rich velvets. Symmetrical geometric patterns were applied for the flooring style flow, while soaring ceilings are often outfitted with custom lacquering, gold-leaf or recessed trays finishes to exaggerate the sense of scale.
